# KeraFirm

> KeraFirm is a Topical nail & skin conditioners. KeraFirm Pro is a topical cosmetic applicator made to condition, soothe and improve the look of nails and the skin around them. It is typically brushed onto fingernails, toenails and nearby cuticles as part of a daily routine, and is positioned as an appearance-focused cosmetic rather than a treatment for medical nail conditions.
